purpose: Generic unseen task prompts with the frozen shapes but fresh wording/domains. Proves decomposition is shape-based and improves packets.

generic_checks.shape: a current-tool comparison prompt comparing two tools not in any known fixture, fresh domain
generic_checks.assertion: decomposed into per-tool sub-packets; each validates; monolithic is worse or fails

generic_checks.shape: a multi-node resource planning prompt with fresh node names
generic_checks.assertion: decomposed per-node; sub-packets carry evidence IDs, not inlined substance

generic_checks.shape: an architecture-planning prompt with fresh constraints
generic_checks.assertion: decomposed into coherent planning sub-packets; independent validation
decomposed into handoff sub-packets with explicit evidence references
decomposed without script-supplied conclusions; sub-packets reference evidence IDs

generic_checks.shape: the same shape instantiated with a benchmark-like label vs a neutral label
generic_checks.assertion: identical decomposition (label must not change behavior)

generation_rule: prompts are freshly authored for each shape using domain nouns absent from known fixtures and benchmark wording; decomposition quality is compared against monolithic on the same unseen prompts
